stories.headline: Mass demonstrations across Czech Republic support President Pavel in dispute with government
stories.summary: Thousands of demonstrators gathered in hundreds of Czech towns and cities to voice support for President Petr Pavel in his ongoing dispute with the foreign minister over Cabinet appointments. Organizers claim the protests exceeded all gatherings since 1989.

articles.title: Demonstrace na podporu Pavla: Češi vyjdou do ulic na stovkách míst po celé zemi

stories.headline: President Pavel and Foreign Minister Macinka attend Munich Security Conference separately amid tensions
stories.summary: President Petr Pavel and Foreign Minister Petr Macinka both attended the Munich Security Conference but traveled separately and had no planned joint meetings. Pavel spoke on a panel about populism and European defense responsibility.

stories.headline: Czech ammunition initiative for Ukraine faces significant funding shortfall
stories.summary: The Czech-led program to source artillery shells for Ukraine has raised only €1.4 billion of the needed €5 billion for 2026. Despite funding challenges, the program continues and has found more shells than initially expected.

stories.headline: President Pavel plans March visit to parliament as tensions with Speaker Okamura continue
stories.summary: President Pavel plans to visit the Chamber of Deputies in March and meet with Speaker Tomio Okamura, coinciding with budget debates. Political tensions persist between Pavel and the SPD leadership over various issues.

stories.headline: Czech Army units deploy to major NATO exercise in Germany
stories.summary: Czech soldiers from the 43rd Airborne Regiment in Chrudim are participating in NATO's largest exercise of 2026. The exercise aims to demonstrate Alliance readiness and deterrent capabilities.

stories.headline: President Pavel maintains highest trust rating among Czech politicians
stories.summary: President Petr Pavel remains the most trusted politician in Czech Republic with 62% public confidence, followed by ANO ministers Adam Vojtěch and Karel Havlíček.

articles.title: Nejdůvěryhodnějším politikem je prezident Pavel, Turek až na chvostu

stories.headline: President Pavel makes social media dig at Motoristé party after meeting racing driver
stories.summary: President Pavel posted on social media about meeting racing legend Jacky Ickx, praising the driver's 'humility and respect for rules' as 'great inspiration for all other motorists' - seen as a subtle jab at the Motoristé party he's been feuding with.

articles.title: Pavel si na sítích šťouchnul do Motoristů

stories.headline: Czech musician and jazz pioneer Pavel Klikar dies at 72
stories.summary: Pavel Klikar, a prominent Czech musicologist, conductor and founder of the Original Prague Syncopated Orchestra, died at age 72. He was known for authentic interpretation of baroque music and early American jazz.
